mechanism: Both agents cause vasodilation and reduce blood pressure through different mechanisms (loop diuretic and ARB), with additive hypotensive effects and potential for electrolyte abnormalities (hyperkalemia risk from valsartan combined with volume depletion from torsemide).
action: Monitor blood pressure regularly, assess renal function and electrolytes periodically, adjust torsemide dose if needed, and counsel patient on orthostatic hypotension symptoms.
